title: Comet Dash
pitch: A space cat in a bubble helmet dodges comets and grabs stars in a speeding starfield.
coreLoop: The cat floats along the bottom of a starfield. Comets and stars fall from the top; both fall faster and spawn more often as the run goes on.
winLose: No win state. A comet touching the cat ends the run.
scoring: +1 per second survived, +10 per star grabbed.
lookAndFeel: Deep-space gradient, twinkling stars, a round-helmet space cat with a thruster trail, spark bursts and screen shake on a hit.
sound: A chime on star pickup, a soft tick per second, a low thud on a hit.

acceptance.text: A comet overlapping the cat ends the run (state().scene === 'over').
Grabbing a star adds 10 to state().score and removes that star.
start() moves the scene from 'title' to 'playing' with score 0.
